Which statement best distinguishes a dimension from a quantity?

```{mcq}
#| label: d01-dimension-quantity
1. A dimension is an aspect of a system; a quantity is a measurable way of representing that aspect. [correct]
2. A quantity is an aspect of a system; a dimension is always a number.
3. Dimension and quantity mean exactly the same thing.
4. A dimension must be measured in meters.
```
:::
